cases.title: Spirited Away
cases.question: What happens to Chihiro’s parents after they eat the unattended food?
cases.reference_excerpt: Spirits begin to appear, and Chihiro discovers that her parents have been transformed into pigs and that she cannot cross the now-flooded river.

cases.title: Spirited Away
cases.question: Who works in the bathhouse boiler room?

cases.title: The Dark Knight
cases.question: Who turns out to be the last surviving robber in the opening bank heist?
cases.reference_excerpt: A gang of masked criminals rob a mafia-owned bank in Gotham City, betraying and killing each other until the sole survivor, the Joker, reveals himself as the mastermind and escapes with the money.

cases.title: The Dark Knight
cases.question: Why does Bruce publicly support Harvey Dent as Gotham’s protector?
cases.reference_answer: He hopes Dent’s success will let him retire as Batman
cases.reference_excerpt: Batman's true identity, the billionaire Bruce Wayne, publicly supports Dent as Gotham's legitimate protector, believing Dent's success will allow him to retire as Batman and romantically pursue his childhood friend Rachel Dawes—despite her being with Dent.

cases.title: The Matrix
cases.question: What is Neo’s name outside his hacker identity?

cases.title: The Matrix
cases.question: Which pill does Neo take to uncover the truth about the Matrix?
cases.reference_excerpt: Neo takes the red pill and awakens in the real world, submerged in a mechanical pod and connected to invasive cables.

cases.question: What does Saito promise Cobb in exchange for completing the job?
